checkpoint_review: I agree with the Router's assessment of all checkpoints. The 'Dimensions vary...' checkpoint is correctly marked as untestable due to cropping. The 'Surface shows scuff marks' is correctly marked as not present/testable given the lighting and resolution. The presence of the stage, proscenium edge, lighting rigs (inferred), and backdrop supports are all correctly identified. The expert classifier confirms the 'stage' label with high confidence, supporting the alignment verdicts.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified significant structural artifacts in the background instrument cases (severity 3) and text gibberish (severity 4). These are critical failures in a scene meant to depict a realistic performance environment. The Router also noted texture anomalies on the subjects (severity 2). I agree with these severities. The perceptual quality auditor found only slight noise, which is negligible compared to the structural melting of the background objects. The geometric depth auditor did not flag specific issues, but the visual evidence of the melted cases is undeniable and overrides the lack of automated depth flags for those specific small objects. The artifact score must be penalized heavily for the incoherent background geometry.
alignment_reasoning: All testable checkpoints passed. Expert classifier strongly confirms 'stage' class. Contextual elements like lighting and curtains support the classification perfectly. No alignment deductions needed.
artifact_reasoning: Severe structural collapse in background equipment (guitar cases appear melted/fused with gibberish text). This is a major artifact in a static scene. Subject textures show minor AI smearing. Background structural failure significantly impacts realism despite strong overall composition.
